name: Black Bean & Pumpkin Chili with Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the bell peppers lengthwise; remove and discard the stems, seeds, and membranes. Medium dice the peppers into 1 ¼-cm cubes and transfer to a medium bowl.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the saucepan heats up, trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into 6-mm pieces and add to the bowl with the peppers.
Once the saucepan is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the bell peppers and onion to the saucepan; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
While the vegetables cook, open the cans of beans but don't drain.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add the garlic, chili powder, cumin, and cinnamon to the saucepan; stir until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp chili powder
3 tsp cumin
¾ tsp cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Add the beans, diced tomatoes, and pumpkin purée to the saucepan; season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) can diced tomatoes
1 ½ (398 ml) can pure pumpkin purée
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into 6-mm pieces at an angle. Stir ¾ of the green onions into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
To serve, divide the chili between bowls and top with the cheddar and remaining green onions. Enjoy!
